We're looking for a Software Development Engineer II who thrives in ambiguity, thinks like a product architect, and brings a builder's mindset to defensive security. Foundational Systems for 1,000+ Engineers

**About The IT Product Team**

**Description**
Build the high-throughput, low-latency systems that power Sponsored Products and Brands (SPB) ads retrieval — handling billions of requests per day with millisecond response times to help shoppers discover new products they love and help advertisers grow their business on Amazon. You'll work at the intersection of search architecture, information retrieval, NLP, and deep learning at massive scale.
  
  
The SPB Search Sourcing Index team owns the Ads Searching, Selection, and Ads Matching systems within Sponsored Products and Brands — one of Amazon's fastest growing and most profitable businesses. Our solutions drive step increases in sponsored ad coverage across the retail website, ensuring relevant ads are served to hundreds of millions of Amazon customers. You'll design, build, and operate distributed systems that process massive datasets, meet strict SLA requirements, and break fresh ground in product and technical innovation every day. This is a high-growth team with a broad mandate to experiment and innovate — collaborative, fast-moving, and entrepreneurial.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Design, develop, and operate high-throughput, low-latency distributed systems handling billions of requests per day with millisecond response times
* Build and optimize ad searching, selection, and matching systems that drive relevant sponsored ad delivery across Amazon's retail surfaces
* Work with massive datasets using distributed frameworks to improve ad coverage, relevance, and performance
* Innovate in search architecture, information retrieval, NLP, and deep learning to advance ad matching capabilities
* Troubleshoot and support high-volume production systems while maintaining strict SLA requirements
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver solutions that help shoppers discover products and help advertisers meet their business objectives
* Mentor junior engineers and guide them to deliver high-impact products and services

We are at the forefront of re-inventing advertising experiences, bridging human creativity with artificial intelligence to transform every aspect of the advertising lifecycle from ad creation and optimization to performance analysis and customer insights. We are a passionate group of innovators dedicated to developing responsible and intelligent AI technologies that balance the needs of advertisers, enhance the shopping experience, and strengthen the marketplace. If you're energized by solving complex challenges and pushing the boundaries of what's possible with AI, join us in shaping the future of advertising.

* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

* Experience working with Data & AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage

**Description**
Amazon's network carries traffic for hundreds of millions of customers, and the Network Monitoring and Remediation (NMR) team keeps it healthy. As a Software Development Engineer II on NMR, you will build streaming data pipelines, automated remediation services, and diagnostic tooling that detect and resolve network impairments before customers ever notice. You will work across the full software development lifecycle, turning ambiguous problems into well-designed, maintainable solutions. If you are a collaborative engineer who enjoys solving hard distributed-systems problems and mentoring teammates along the way, this is a role where your code has real, measurable impact every single day.

Design and build streaming data pipelines that ingest network telemetry at scale, and develop the automated remediation services that act on those signals in real time.
  
  
Create and improve diagnostic tooling that helps network operators quickly identify and resolve the issues automation has not yet addressed.
  
  
Participate actively in code reviews, provide constructive feedback to teammates, and mentor other engineers on writing well-documented, reliable software.

Network Monitoring and Remediation (NMR) prevents, predicts, detects, and remediates network impairments before they reach customers. Our systems ingest trillions of telemetry data points daily from millions of network devices, apply streaming analytics and ML/AI to surface actionable signals, and drive automated mitigation through our event management platform. Today, over 98% of detected issues are resolved without human intervention. Our vision is a future where every network failure is pre-emptively resolved by autonomous systems, with zero customer impact.

**Who We Are**
Solana is the leading high-performance network powering internet capital markets, payments, and crypto applications, built to become the capital market for every asset on earth. Anza is the core engineering team behind it. Founded by the engineers who built the original Solana validator client at Solana Labs, we develop Agave, the network's primary and most widely run validator client, and ship the software that pushes the boundaries of blockchain performance and scale.
  
  
We advance the frontier of Solana's core protocol. Most recently, Anza built and shipped Alpenglow, the biggest upgrade in Solana's history, replacing the network's original consensus protocol and bringing deterministic finality in about 150ms to mainnet-beta. And we're just getting started, with work underway on faster block propagation, quicker leader handoffs, and the infrastructure that will carry Solana's next phase of growth.
  
  
**The Role**
As a Software Engineer specializing in storage, you will play a critical role in fortifying Anza's Agave client and the broader Solana network. The AccountsDB team owns the custom storage engine at the heart of every Solana validator. Every account on Solana, from balances to program state to token holdings, lives in AccountsDB, and every transaction the network processes reads from and writes to it.
  
  
Your work will directly contribute to the performance and reliability of our blockchain infrastructure, ensuring account state is stored, indexed, and served efficiently as the network grows.
  
  
**Requirements**
**Responsibilities**

* Develop and Optimize the Storage Engine: Design, implement, and optimize AccountsDB's core storage paths, including account file layout, the account index, and the read and write caching layers, to improve throughput and latency across the validator
* Reduce Resource Footprint: Lower memory and disk requirements as account state continues to grow, to keep validator hardware requirements in check
* Background Services: Improve the flushing, cleaning, shrinking, and purging processes to reduce write amplification and keep resource usage predictable under sustained load
* Snapshots and Startup: Optimize snapshot generation, loading, and index generation to shorten validator startup and catch-up times
* Correctness and Integrity: Ensure account state remains correct across forks, rooting, and crash recovery, where bugs can have network-wide consequences
* Testing and Validation: Create and execute comprehensive tests to validate the reliability and efficiency of the storage engine, including stress tests, fault injection, and performance benchmarking
* Collaboration: Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including runtime, block production, and core protocol engineers, as well as other Solana client teams, to ensure seamless integration of storage components across the validator
* Documentation and Code Review: Maintain thorough documentation of AccountsDB design and behavior and conduct peer code reviews to uphold high standards of code quality and consistency

**What You'll Bring**

* Systems Engineering Background: Bachelor's degree in CS, Engineering, or relevant practical experience, alongside 3+ years architecting data stores, file systems, databases, or high-throughput storage systems
* Systems Languages & Storage Architecture: Mastery of Rust, C, or C++. Comprehensive grasp of low-level storage mechanics, including memory-mapped files, page caching, index structures, on-disk formats, and garbage collection mechanisms
* I/O Subsystems: Advanced knowledge of kernel-level and hardware I/O pipelines, NVMe constraints, buffered versus direct I/O, and modern async interfaces like io\_uring
* Kernel & Memory Management: Strong understanding of custom memory allocators and Linux kernel scheduling, page management, and I/O handling under intense throughput
* Concurrent Programming: Proven experience building concurrent systems, featuring deep knowledge of lock overhead, lock-free structures, and hardware memory models
* Profiling and Optimization: Track record of profiling and tuning low-level code with an emphasis on hardware mechanics, memory bus saturation, and CPU cache efficiency
* Systemic Problem Solving: Ability to debug intricate software architectures, isolate performance bottlenecks, and execute robust engineering solutions
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Exceptional communication skills and a team-first mindset for working alongside technical peers in an open environment

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with LSM trees, B-trees, or hash-based storage engines such as RocksDB, LevelDB, or WiredTiger
* Background in versioned or multi-version data stores, snapshotting systems, or blockchain state storage
* Familiarity with Linux, systems automation tools, and systems architecture
* Active participation in Bitcoin/Ethereum/Blockchain projects or the open-source community is highly desirable

What we are building
  
  
Mimica is an AI-powered process intelligence platform enabling enterprises and individuals to reclaim their most precious resource: time. We've all seen repetitive tasks and redundant processes quietly drain productivity and creativity. Not because companies don’t want to become more efficient, but because they don’t know where to start.
  
  
Mimica automatically analyzes your team’s work, then generates the AI agents to execute it. Our software turns everyday work into data-backed decisions, helping companies remove process bottlenecks, automate the right tasks, and upskill teams with precision and confidence.

**Our team**
Behind our platform is a team of exceptionally talented people, remote-first and globally distributed across 16+ countries. We're looking for curious, collaborative people excited to solve complex problems. You'll join a fast-paced environment built on high ownership, bottom-up thinking, and transparent, open communication – helping some of the world's leading organizations transform the way work gets done with AI.
  
  
**Your Mission**
We're hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to join Mimica's Intelligent Automation team. You'll embed with our enterprise customers, turn process and task-mining insights into working automations, and get them into production fast. This is a hands-on, customer-facing engineering role with a strong focus on agentic AI.
  
  
You'll design and ship AI agents built on frontier models such as Claude and Gemini, combine them with RPA and custom code running on Google Cloud, and bring what you learn in the field back to our product and delivery playbooks. As a senior member of the team, you'll also act as a technical leader and mentor for our Intelligent Automation developers, helping them grow their skills in RPA, AI, and engineering best practices.

* Own customer deployments end to end – from discovery and solution design through build, testing, go-live and hypercare.

* Lead and mentor Intelligent Automation developers – guide developers through design and code reviews, pairing and coaching; help them adopt agentic AI and engineering best practices.

* Ship production-grade work – work in Git (branching, pull requests, code reviews) with automated testing, CI/CD, monitoring, exception handling, and security practices that meet enterprise standards.
* Measure and prove value – track hours saved, error rates, and throughput, and present ROI to customer sponsors.

* Strong Python skills, plus solid experience with REST APIs, JSON, SQL and system integration.

Through purposeful innovation and the strength of its connections, CCC technologies empower the people and industry relied upon to keep lives moving forward when it matters most. Learn more about CCC at www.cccis.com.
  
  
**The Role**
As an AI Engineer you will build and ship LLM-powered features and agentic workflows for our customers. These features automate the routine parts of a claim and guide customers on the rest, so they have to earn that trust with measured accuracy, not a convincing demo. Agents run as steps inside deterministic workflows, and privacy and security are design baselines, not review gates. Agentic coding tools are how you move fast. What you add is what they are worst at: system design, security, and hard debugging. You own features end to end.
  
  
**Salary Range Is**
$170,000 - 195,000
  
  
This position is bonus eligible.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Ship LLM-powered features and agentic workflows in Python and TypeScript, from a problem scoped with product managers and data scientists through production traffic, and help set the metrics you will be measured against.
* Write the evals, guardrails, and feedback loops that make your features trustworthy, and hold them to explicit token and latency budgets.
* Use agentic coding tools every day, and own the review of what they produce: catch the correctness, security, and design problems in generated code before you open the pull request.
* Maintain and extend the NLP pipelines that turn unstructured claim data into structured data customers can act on, blending semantic search, classical NLP, and LLMs.
* Build and operate durable, event-driven services in which agents run as steps inside deterministic workflows, with checkpointed model outputs so a retry does not re-invoke a completed LLM step.
* Trace every model call and agent step so a recommendation can be reconstructed and audited, with citations back to the source documents, and wire that tracing into your alerts.
* Model and query claims data across relational, document, and graph stores.
* Design privacy and security in from the start: tenant isolation, least-privilege access for agents and their tools, and a clear rule for what data may reach a model provider.
* Write a technical design document before any significant change, and use it to get feedback and buy-in from the team before you build.
* Take part in a shared on-call rotation for the services you build.

**Requirements**

* 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, including at least one LLM-powered feature you shipped and then operated in production.
* Python and TypeScript: typed, tested, async code in both, and real depth in one.
* Evals you have designed for LLM output, plus guardrails you have shipped.
* A clear account of how you constrain an agentic coding tool's context and verify its output, from daily use of Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar on production work.
* Pipelines that blend LLMs with semantic search and classical NLP: structured output, tool calling, embedding-based retrieval, and a case where a classical technique beat an LLM.
* Services built on message- or event-driven architectures, including long-running workflows with retries, idempotent handlers, and event-sourced state, plus an LLM or agent step you ran inside one.
* Data modeling and development across relational, document, and graph databases such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Neo4j, including when each type fits and the partition-key, consistency, and tenant-isolation calls you made.

**The Role**
As a Software Engineer specializing in storage, you will play a critical role in fortifying Anza's Agave client and the broader Solana network. The AccountsDB team owns the custom storage engine at the heart of every Solana validator. Every account on Solana, from balances to program state to token holdings, lives in AccountsDB, and every transaction the network processes reads from and writes to it.
  
  
Your work will directly contribute to the performance and reliability of our blockchain infrastructure, ensuring account state is stored, indexed, and served efficiently as the network grows.
  
  
**Requirements**
**Responsibilities**

* Develop and Optimize the Storage Engine: Design, implement, and optimize AccountsDB's core storage paths, including account file layout, the account index, and the read and write caching layers, to improve throughput and latency across the validator
* Reduce Resource Footprint: Lower memory and disk requirements as account state continues to grow, to keep validator hardware requirements in check
* Background Services: Improve the flushing, cleaning, shrinking, and purging processes to reduce write amplification and keep resource usage predictable under sustained load
* Snapshots and Startup: Optimize snapshot generation, loading, and index generation to shorten validator startup and catch-up times
* Correctness and Integrity: Ensure account state remains correct across forks, rooting, and crash recovery, where bugs can have network-wide consequences
* Testing and Validation: Create and execute comprehensive tests to validate the reliability and efficiency of the storage engine, including stress tests, fault injection, and performance benchmarking
* Collaboration: Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including runtime, block production, and core protocol engineers, as well as other Solana client teams, to ensure seamless integration of storage components across the validator
* Documentation and Code Review: Maintain thorough documentation of AccountsDB design and behavior and conduct peer code reviews to uphold high standards of code quality and consistency

**What You'll Bring**

* Systems Engineering Background: Bachelor's degree in CS, Engineering, or relevant practical experience, alongside 3+ years architecting data stores, file systems, databases, or high-throughput storage systems
* Systems Languages & Storage Architecture: Mastery of Rust, C, or C++. Comprehensive grasp of low-level storage mechanics, including memory-mapped files, page caching, index structures, on-disk formats, and garbage collection mechanisms
* I/O Subsystems: Advanced knowledge of kernel-level and hardware I/O pipelines, NVMe constraints, buffered versus direct I/O, and modern async interfaces like io\_uring
* Kernel & Memory Management: Strong understanding of custom memory allocators and Linux kernel scheduling, page management, and I/O handling under intense throughput
* Concurrent Programming: Proven experience building concurrent systems, featuring deep knowledge of lock overhead, lock-free structures, and hardware memory models
* Profiling and Optimization: Track record of profiling and tuning low-level code with an emphasis on hardware mechanics, memory bus saturation, and CPU cache efficiency
* Systemic Problem Solving: Ability to debug intricate software architectures, isolate performance bottlenecks, and execute robust engineering solutions
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Exceptional communication skills and a team-first mindset for working alongside technical peers in an open environment

* Develop and Optimize the Storage Engine: Design, implement, and optimize AccountsDB's core storage paths, including account file layout, the account index, and the read and write caching layers, to improve throughput and latency across the validator
* Reduce Resource Footprint: Lower memory and disk requirements as account state continues to grow, to keep validator hardware requirements in check
* Background Services: Improve the flushing, cleaning, shrinking, and purging processes to reduce write amplification and keep resource usage predictable under sustained load
* Snapshots and Startup: Optimize snapshot generation, loading, and index generation to shorten validator startup and catch-up times
* Correctness and Integrity: Ensure account state remains correct across forks, rooting, and crash recovery, where bugs can have network-wide consequences
* Testing and Validation: Create and execute comprehensive tests to validate the reliability and efficiency of the storage engine, including stress tests, fault injection, and performance benchmarking
* Collaboration: Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including runtime, block production, and core protocol engineers, as well as other Solana client teams, to ensure seamless integration of storage components across the validator
* Documentation and Code Review: Maintain thorough documentation of AccountsDB design and behavior and conduct peer code reviews to uphold high standards of code quality and consistency

**What You'll Bring**

* Systems Engineering Background: Bachelor's degree in CS, Engineering, or relevant practical experience, alongside 3+ years architecting data stores, file systems, databases, or high-throughput storage systems
* Systems Languages & Storage Architecture: Mastery of Rust, C, or C++. Comprehensive grasp of low-level storage mechanics, including memory-mapped files, page caching, index structures, on-disk formats, and garbage collection mechanisms
* I/O Subsystems: Advanced knowledge of kernel-level and hardware I/O pipelines, NVMe constraints, buffered versus direct I/O, and modern async interfaces like io\_uring
* Kernel & Memory Management: Strong understanding of custom memory allocators and Linux kernel scheduling, page management, and I/O handling under intense throughput
* Concurrent Programming: Proven experience building concurrent systems, featuring deep knowledge of lock overhead, lock-free structures, and hardware memory models
* Profiling and Optimization: Track record of profiling and tuning low-level code with an emphasis on hardware mechanics, memory bus saturation, and CPU cache efficiency
* Systemic Problem Solving: Ability to debug intricate software architectures, isolate performance bottlenecks, and execute robust engineering solutions
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Exceptional communication skills and a team-first mindset for working alongside technical peers in an open environment

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with LSM trees, B-trees, or hash-based storage engines such as RocksDB, LevelDB, or WiredTiger
* Background in versioned or multi-version data stores, snapshotting systems, or blockchain state storage
* Familiarity with Linux, systems automation tools, and systems architecture
* Active participation in Bitcoin/Ethereum/Blockchain projects or the open-source community is highly desirable

**Job Title: Embedded Software Engineer**
**Job Description**
This role focuses on designing, developing, and maintaining low-level embedded software for mission systems applications in the aviation, space, and defense domains. You will work closely with hardware platforms and avionics subsystems to deliver safety-critical solutions that meet rigorous certification standards such as DO-178B and DO-178C. The position offers the opportunity to contribute across the full software lifecycle, from requirements analysis through verification and validation, while collaborating with multidisciplinary engineering teams.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain low-level embedded software for mission systems applications.
* Interface directly with hardware platforms and avionics subsystems to implement and support embedded solutions.
* Support software integration activities, including bringing up new hardware, integrating software components, and resolving integration issues.
* Perform detailed software debugging to identify, analyze, and resolve defects and performance issues.
* Collaborate closely with systems, hardware, and test engineering teams to ensure cohesive and robust system designs.
* Participate in requirements analysis to understand, refine, and decompose system and software requirements.
* Implement software features and components in C and/or C++ in accordance with project and industry standards.
* Contribute to verification and validation efforts, including test planning, test execution, and documentation of results.
* Support DO-178B and DO-178C certification activities and software lifecycle processes for safety-critical applications.
* Troubleshoot hardware and software integration issues throughout the development lifecycle.
* Work with avionics communication interfaces such as ARINC 429, MIL-STD-1553, Ethernet, or serial interfaces when applicable.
* Assist in maintaining compliance with systems safety, avionics certification, and airworthiness requirements.

**Essential Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* Minimum 1 year of embedded software development experience.
* Minimum 1 year of experience with low-level embedded software development.
* Minimum 1 year of experience developing software in C and/or C++.
* Demonstrated experience with Design Assurance Level (DAL) A or DAL B safety-critical software.
* Minimum 1 year of experience supporting software development under DO-178B or DO-178C standards.
* Minimum 1 year of experience performing software integration and debugging activities.
* Minimum 1 year of experience working directly with hardware interfaces and embedded systems.
* Ability to work effectively with mission systems and avionics subsystems.
* Strong debugging skills for low-level embedded software and hardware interactions.
* Comfort working in a structured, safety-critical software lifecycle environment.

**Additional Skills & Qualifications**

* Ability to support periodic travel or rotational onsite work in Cedar Rapids, Iowa.
* Experience in aerospace, avionics, or defense industry environments.
* Experience supporting mission systems applications.
* Experience with real-time operating systems (RTOS) such as VxWorks or Green Hills Integrity.
* Experience with Board Support Packages (BSPs).
* Device driver development experience for embedded platforms.
* Experience with avionics communication protocols such as ARINC 429, MIL-STD-1553, Ethernet, or serial interfaces.
* Experience supporting safety-critical software development beyond minimum requirements.
* Active security clearance or the ability to obtain one, where applicable.
* Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work in multidisciplinary engineering teams.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills for technical documentation and cross-team coordination.

**Work Environment**
The role offers a hybrid work model centered around Cedar Rapids, Iowa. A typical hybrid arrangement may include two weeks working remotely followed by two weeks onsite in Cedar Rapids, providing a balance between in-person collaboration and remote flexibility. A fully onsite option is also available, with work performed on location in Cedar Rapids five days per week. Fully remote arrangements may be considered on a case-by-case basis, depending on project needs and candidate suitability. You will work in a safety-critical, engineering-focused environment that emphasizes avionics certification, systems safety, and airworthiness compliance. The work involves close interaction with hardware platforms, avionics subsystems, and embedded development tools, as well as collaboration with systems, hardware, and test engineering teams. The culture values technical excellence, rigorous engineering practices, and long-term partnerships across aviation, space, and defense programs.
